name: CDimm::InternalDemand
needs: ours also wrong: ours light-returns when ((pRes->dwFlags & RES_FLAG_0x04) != 0 && pRes != field_CE && (pRes->dwFlags & RES_FLAG_0x10) != 0), but the exe routes (F4 == 0 || pRes == field_CE || F10 != 0) into the locked section at 0x783f39 (0x783ef9-0x783f0a) and its fallthrough light path (F4 != 0 && new res && F10 == 0) sets RES_FLAG_0x20, calls the CRes vtable+0x10 slot (0x783f1d), then converts 0x20 to 0x40 (0x7840a5-0x7840b2); ours never calls the handler nor sets 0x40 in the light path, and routes the F10 == 0 case into the locked section instead. Fix: invert the gate (locked section when (pRes->dwFlags & 0x04) == 0 || pRes == field_CE || (pRes->dwFlags & 0x10) != 0) and make the light path set 0x20, call the vtable+0x10 slot, and set 0x40.
